description: React component for managing channel details in Mattermost admin console, including access control, group management, permissions, and channel policies.

classes.name: ChannelDetails
classes.description: React component for managing detailed settings of a Mattermost channel, including permissions, group associations, access policies, and channel-specific rules.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when component receives new props, such as loading user attributes and policies if ABAC is supported, and loading channel-level access rules if policy is enforced.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial data loading when component mounts, including fetching channel info, permissions, group info, and policies.

methods.name: restrictChannelMentions
methods.description: Disables use_channel_mentions permission for roles that have create_post disabled or not enabled.

methods.name: setToggles
methods.description: Sets privacy and sync toggles, updates state, and processes group changes.

methods.name: processGroupsChange
methods.description: Handles changes in group memberships, including server-side updates and error handling.

methods.name: handleGroupRemoved
methods.description: Removes a group from state and updates server.

methods.name: setNewGroupRole
methods.description: Toggles scheme admin role for a specific group.

methods.name: channelPermissionsChanged
methods.description: Updates permissions roles for a specific permission and role, with special handling for create_post and use_channel_mentions.

methods.name: handleGroupChange
methods.description: Adds new groups to current group list and processes changes.

methods.name: hideConvertConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the convert confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideRemoveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the remove confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideConvertAndRemoveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the convert and remove confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideArchiveConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the archive confirmation modal.

methods.name: hideAccessRulesConfirmModal
methods.description: Hides the access rules confirmation modal and resets related state.

methods.name: confirmAccessRulesSave
methods.description: Confirms and proceeds with saving access rules after user approval.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles save button click, including validation and showing confirmation modals for privacy or archive changes.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Performs the actual save operation, including updating privacy, group memberships, permissions, and access policies, with error handling and server communication.

methods.name: loadUserAttributes
methods.description: Fetches user attributes for ABAC support, handling API responses and errors.

methods.name: loadChannelLevelAccessRules
methods.description: Loads channel-specific access policy and rules, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: combineParentAndChannelExpressions
methods.description: Combines parent policy expressions with channel expression using AND logic.

methods.name: calculateMembershipChanges
methods.description: Calculates user membership changes based on combined access policy expressions and current channel members.

methods.name: fetchAccessControlPolicies
methods.description: Fetches access control policies for a given channel, including imported policies.
